styles.title: Wings
styles.style_zh: 默片 3D 空战 · 正色片黑白 + 琥珀染色
styles.desc_en: A three.js dogfight graded like a 1927 orthochromatic print: white skies, deep blacks, an amber tint, gate weave and scratches. Wings is remembered for aerial combat shot from cameras strapped to the planes, so most cameras here ride on the planes.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 搭的一战空战，按 1927 年正色片拷贝调色：天空发白、黑位很深、整体琥珀染色、片门抖动和划痕。《翼》最出名的是把摄影机绑在飞机上拍的空战，所以这里大部分机位都装在飞机上。

styles.title: The Broadway Melody
styles.style_zh: 黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报
styles.desc_en: An Art Deco revue poster in black, gold and silver: airbrushed gradients, a stepped proscenium, a chrome condenser mic. It is 1929 Broadway at the height of Deco, and the film where sound arrives, so rings of sound pour out of the mic.
styles.desc_zh: 会动的黑金银装饰艺术歌舞海报：喷枪渐变、阶梯形台口、镀铬电容麦克风。1929 年的百老汇正是装饰艺术盛期，这部又是有声片降临的一部，所以让声波从麦克风里一圈圈放出来。

styles.title: All Quiet on the Western Front
styles.desc_en: A woodcut after Käthe Kollwitz: big masses of black, white knife-cut contours, rough grain, with Clawd printed from its own orange block. Kollwitz's German anti-war prints of 1921–22 come from the same war and the same grief as the film.
styles.desc_zh: 珂勒惠支式木刻：大块的黑、刀刻的白轮廓、粗糙木纹，Clawd 用单独一块橙色版套印。珂勒惠支 1921–22 年的反战版画，和这部片出自同一场战争、同一种悲痛。

styles.title: Cimarron
styles.desc_en: A gold-toned albumen panorama of 1889: soft lens, a little pan blur, cream highlights and umber shadows, silver grain; only Clawd is hand-tinted. Cimarron opens on the 1889 land rush, so it is shot as a photograph of that year, keeping the chapter monochrome.
styles.desc_zh: 1889 年的金调色蛋白印相全景：柔焦、轻微的横向拖影、奶油高光和暖褐暗部、银盐颗粒，只有 Clawd 手工上色。片子开场就是 1889 年俄克拉何马圈地狂奔，用那一年的照片质感来拍，这一章也保持单色。

styles.title: Grand Hotel
styles.style_zh: 米高梅银色黑白 3D 大堂
styles.desc_en: A three.js model of the circular lobby, graded in MGM's silver black and white with Clawd's orange as the only colour. The film's best-known image is the shot straight down the well, galleries closing in rings, so the set is built around it.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的圆形大堂，按米高梅的银色黑白调色，Clawd 的橙是唯一的颜色。这部片最出名的是从顶上笔直往下拍、回廊一圈圈收进去的镜头，整个布景就按这一镜来建。

styles.title: Cavalcade
styles.desc_en: A Mucha-style Art Nouveau panel: swelling brown outlines, pastel flats, a mosaic ground and a halo behind the central figure. Cavalcade opens on New Year's Eve 1899 with a family toasting the new century, so the halo is a clock striking twelve.
styles.desc_zh: 慕夏式新艺术装饰画：膨胀的褐色轮廓线、粉彩平涂、马赛克底，中心人物身后一个光环。电影开场就是 1899 年跨年夜一家人举杯迎接新世纪，所以光环做成敲十二点的钟面。

styles.title: It Happened One Night
styles.desc_en: A 1934 black-and-white rubber-hose cartoon: thick-thin ink, pie-cut eyes, white gloves, cel shading over grey watercolour backgrounds, with film grain. It is the film's own year, and a road comedy gag suits cartoon timing.
styles.desc_zh: 1934 年的黑白橡皮管卡通：粗细变化的墨线、饼切眼、白手套，赛璐璐平涂叠在灰阶水彩背景上，带胶片颗粒。和电影同一年，公路喜剧的笑点也适合卡通的节奏。

styles.title: Mutiny on the Bounty
styles.desc_en: An 18th-century Admiralty sea chart engraved in copperplate, with rhumb lines, compass roses, soundings and thin hand colour; the Bounty is a ship vignette on the sheet. The film is a voyage, so the whole film stays on the chart.
styles.desc_zh: 18 世纪英国海军部海图的铜版画：恒向线、罗盘玫瑰、水深数字、手工淡彩，邦蒂号是图上的一幅船舶插画。这部片讲的是一次航行，所以整段都留在海图上。

styles.title: The Great Ziegfeld
styles.style_zh: 银色黑白 3D 螺旋婚礼蛋糕舞台
styles.desc_en: A three.js model of the revolving spiral 'wedding cake' stage in MGM's silver black and white: satin, chiffon and ostrich feathers against deep black, Clawd the only colour. The 175-step spiral of 'A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody' is the film's famous set piece.
styles.desc_zh: 用 three.js 建的旋转螺旋“婚礼蛋糕”舞台，米高梅银色黑白：缎面、雪纺和鸵鸟羽毛衬在深黑里，只有 Clawd 是颜色。《A Pretty Girl Is Like a Melody》那座 175 级的螺旋舞台是这部片的名场面。

styles.title: The Life of Emile Zola
styles.style_zh: 报纸活字印刷 + 线刻插图
styles.desc_en: Letterpress newsprint with 1890s line engraving: a wood-type headline, dense columns of lead type, ink spread and under-inking on yellowed paper, figures in hatching. The film's best-known image is L'Aurore's 'J'Accuse…!' front page of 13 January 1898.
styles.desc_zh: 报纸活字印刷加 1890 年代线刻插图：木活字大标题、密排铅字正文，泛黄新闻纸上的油墨外扩和缺墨，人物用排线画。这部片最有名的画面就是 1898 年 1 月 13 日《震旦报》的《我控诉》头版。

styles.title: You Can't Take It with You
styles.desc_en: A 1930s WPA silkscreen poster: six flat opaque inks, split-fountain gradients, slight misregistration on rag paper. The Federal Art Project posters of 1936–39 were American graphic design of the film's own years, and they keep it apart from No. 10's newsprint.
styles.desc_zh: 30 年代 WPA 丝网海报：六色不透明平涂油墨、分色渐变、轻微套印错位，印在棉浆纸上。1936–39 年联邦艺术计划的海报就是这部片同年代的美国平面语言，也和第 10 部的报纸拉开距离。

styles.title: Gone with the Wind
styles.desc_en: Impasto oil with palette-knife slabs, ridged paint and Technicolor heat: skies burning from gold to blood red, red earth, black silhouettes. Gone with the Wind is where colour arrives in the film, so Tara at sunset is the first fully saturated frame.
styles.desc_zh: 厚涂油画：刮刀色块、颜料堆起的棱，Technicolor 的热度——从金色烧到血红的天空、红土、黑色剪影。全片的色彩从《乱世佳人》开始降临，第一张满色画面就是夕阳下的塔拉。

styles.title: Rebecca
styles.desc_en: Charcoal on toothed paper: velvet blacks, smudged greys, moonlight and mist lifted out with an eraser. Hitchcock's Rebecca is a black-and-white Gothic dream of a house in mist and then in flames, and charcoal can draw both.
styles.desc_zh: 粗纹纸上的炭笔画：天鹅绒般的黑、抹开的灰，月光和雾用橡皮擦出来。希区柯克的《蝴蝶梦》是一场黑白哥特梦，庄园先在雾里、后在火里，炭笔两样都画得出来。

styles.title: How Green Was My Valley
styles.desc_en: Opaque gouache in the 1941 poster's gold and green: solid colour masses, coal-black tips, Kyffin Williams' heavy dark hills and broken contours. Gouache keeps it apart from No. 3's woodcut; the scene is the colliers walking home down the valley, singing.
styles.desc_zh: 用 1941 年原海报金黄加绿配色的不透明水粉：扎实的色块、煤黑的渣山、Kyffin Williams 式厚重的深色山体和断续描边。用水粉而不用木刻，和第 3 部区分开；画的是矿工唱着歌走下山谷回家。

styles.title: Mrs. Miniver
blend_zh: Frank Newbould、Abram Games 二战海报
styles.desc_en: A WWII British Home Front lithograph poster: flat brick red, deep green, cream and grey-blue, with a grainy crayon shadow plate. It fits the film's last scene, a village singing in its bombed church while Spitfires pass overhead.
styles.desc_zh: 二战英国本土战线的石印海报：砖红、深绿、奶油、灰蓝的有限套色，阴影是石版蜡笔颗粒。配影片结尾：被炸穿屋顶的乡村教堂里全村唱诗，喷火式战机从破洞上方飞过。

styles.title: Casablanca
styles.desc_en: The film's own look, Arthur Edeson's studio black-and-white, painted as a retouched glamour still: rich greys, soft-focus close-ups with catchlights, venetian-blind shadows, light shafts in smoke and fog. Clawd, as Rick, is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 影片本身的样子：Arthur Edeson 的片厂黑白，画成精修剧照：带眼神光的柔焦特写、百叶窗投影、烟雾里的光柱。扮里克的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。

styles.title: Going My Way
blend_zh: 铅条拼色玻璃 + 灰调描绘
styles.desc_en: Backlit Gothic stained glass: leaded pot-metal pieces with grisaille-painted faces, Chartres blue, ruby borders, and coloured light pooling on the church floor. Father O'Malley's boys' choir is set into the window under a gold star for 'Swinging on a Star'.
styles.desc_zh: 逆光的哥特彩色玻璃：铅条拼起的色玻璃、灰调描出的人脸、沙特尔蓝和宝石红边框，彩光洒在教堂地上。奥马利神父和唱诗班嵌在窗里，头顶是金色星章。

styles.title: The Lost Weekend
blend_zh: John F. Seitz 硬光黑白
styles.desc_en: The picture is typed: monospaced characters on a pica grid, grey built from character density and overstrikes, uneven ribbon ink on bond paper. Don Birnam lugs his typewriter to the pawnshops, so his own machine types the street; Clawd is struck in orange ribbon.
styles.desc_zh: 画面是打出来的：等宽字符落在 pica 网格上，灰阶靠字符疏密和叠打，色带墨色不匀。唐抱着打字机去当铺，于是整条街由打字机打出；Clawd 用橙色色带打。

styles.title: The Best Years of Our Lives
styles.style_zh: 画报新闻摄影半调跨页
styles.desc_en: A 1946 picture-magazine news photo printed in coarse black halftone on coated stock, with the gutter fold and an overprinted caption. Deep-focus rows of stripped B-17s run to the horizon; Clawd is the only colour, on its own spot-orange plate.
styles.desc_zh: 1946 年画报的新闻摄影跨页：铜版纸上的粗黑网点、中缝折痕、叠印的图片说明。深焦里拆光的 B-17 排到地平线；Clawd 单独印在专色橙版上，是唯一的颜色。

styles.title: Gentleman's Agreement
styles.desc_en: Graphite pencil in the manner of 1940s magazine illustration: construction lines, near-parallel hatching passes, rubbed darks and eraser lifts on toothy paper. The drawing builds itself around a polite refusal at a hotel desk; Clawd alone is in coloured pencil.
styles.desc_zh: 40 年代杂志插画式的石墨铅笔：先打构图线，再一遍遍平行排线，擦抹暗部、橡皮提亮。画面围绕酒店前台一次客气的拒绝逐步画出，只有 Clawd 是彩色铅笔。

styles.title: Hamlet
blend_zh: Roger Furse 光秃的罗马式布景
styles.desc_en: A real-time 3D Elsinore in high-contrast deep-focus black-and-white: volumetric fog, wet stone, swells breaking into lace foam, silver grain. It follows Olivier's castle, foggy battlements and sea rock; Clawd is the only colour, lifting Yorick's skull.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的艾尔西诺，高反差深焦黑白：体积雾、湿石头、碎成蕾丝白沫的海浪、银盐颗粒。照奥利维耶片中的城堡、雾中城垛和礁石来拍；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。

styles.title: All the King's Men
styles.desc_en: A Southern campaign poster in wood-type letterpress: red, blue and black ink on cream stock, wood grain in the solids, starved patches, misregistered formes and halftone portraits. It is Willie Stark's rally; Clawd is printed in a fourth, orange ink.
styles.desc_zh: 南方竞选海报的木活字凸版：红、蓝、黑三色油墨印在米黄纸上，实地有木纹，供墨不匀，版间错位，肖像走半调网点。这是斯塔克的竞选集会，Clawd 用第四版橙墨印。

styles.title: All About Eve
styles.style_zh: 赫希菲尔德一笔画漫画
styles.desc_en: Al Hirschfeld's Broadway caricature: one flowing ink line that swells and tapers, solid blacks against white, lots of empty paper, one exaggerated trait per person. The film is about the theatre, so its party is drawn as a theatre-page cartoon; Clawd is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 艾尔·赫希菲尔德的百老汇漫画：粗细变化的流畅墨线、黑块对白、大量留白，每人只抓一个夸张特征。这部片讲剧场，派对就画成报纸剧场版漫画；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。

styles.title: An American in Paris
blend_zh: 松动墨线 + 错开的色块
styles.desc_en: Raoul Dufy's watercolour: fast blue-black ink lines over big transparent patches of cobalt, lemon and rose that never line up with them. The film's closing ballet was designed after Dufy, so the Place de la Concorde and its dancers are painted his way.
styles.desc_zh: 拉乌尔·杜飞的水彩：快速的蓝黑墨线，底下是钴蓝、柠檬黄、玫瑰红的透明色块，线和色永远对不齐。影片结尾的芭蕾布景就是照杜飞画的，协和广场和舞者都用他的画法。

styles.title: The Greatest Show on Earth
blend_zh: 平涂油墨 + 粗黑轮廓
styles.desc_en: A Strobridge circus lithograph: flat chrome yellow, vermilion and cobalt with heavy black outlines, screened and slightly off register on grainy stone. DeMille's big top becomes a three-ring poster, with Clawd as the Great Sebastian making the poster's trapeze catch.
styles.desc_zh: Strobridge 马戏团彩色石印：铬黄、朱红、钴蓝平涂，粗黑轮廓，带网点、错版和石版颗粒。德米尔的大帐篷画成三圈海报，Clawd 扮塞巴斯蒂安做空中接人。

styles.title: From Here to Eternity
styles.desc_en: 1953 high-key black-and-white: hard sun, dark filtered sky, blown white foam, wet sand mirroring the sky, silver grain and halation. It stages the kiss in the surf at Halona Cove; Clawd, playing the bugle on the lava rock, is the only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 1953 年的高调黑白：硬朗阳光、压暗的天空、泛白的浪沫、映着天的湿沙，银盐颗粒和光晕。拍哈洛纳海湾浪里那一吻；坐在熔岩上吹军号的 Clawd 是唯一的颜色。

styles.title: On the Waterfront
blend_zh: 50 年代美国社会现实主义
styles.desc_en: Ben Shahn's social realism: a trembling, blotted ink line over flat tempera blocks laid slightly off the drawing, big hands and long working faces, restrained slate, brick and ochre. Shahn painted dockers and union halls, which is this film's world.
styles.desc_zh: 本·沙恩的社会现实主义：颤抖的转印墨线，下面是错开的平涂蛋彩色块，大手长脸的工人，颜色克制在灰蓝、砖红、赭黄。沙恩画的就是码头工人和工会，正是这部片的世界。

styles.title: Marty
blend_zh: 暖色 50 年代客厅插画
styles.desc_en: A 1955 kinescope playing on a wood-cabinet TV in a warm Bronx living room: scanlines, phosphor glow, a rounded bulging screen, ghosting and snow, all black-and-white except Clawd. Marty began as a live 1953 TV play, so the film is shown as television.
styles.desc_zh: 1955 年的电视录像，在布朗克斯暖色客厅的电视里播：扫描线、荧光晕、圆角凸屏、雪花，只有 Clawd 有颜色。原作是直播电视剧，所以当电视拍。

styles.title: Around the World in 80 Days
styles.style_zh: 50 年代 UPA 现代主义卡通
styles.desc_en: A flat, geometric 1950s cartoon: colour blocks printed off their ink lines, broken outlines, crayon grain on cream paper. The film's own six-minute end-title animation was made by Saul Bass in this modernist style.
styles.desc_zh: 50 年代平面几何卡通：色块和墨线错位套印、墨线断续、奶油纸上的蜡笔颗粒。本片 6 分钟的片尾动画就出自 Saul Bass，正是这种现代主义画法。

styles.title: The Bridge on the River Kwai
styles.desc_en: A general-arrangement blueprint pinned to a drafting table: white lines on Prussian blue, folds, water stains, red-pencil revisions. The film is about a colonel obsessed with building a perfect bridge, so the bridge appears as his engineering drawing.
styles.desc_zh: 钉在绘图桌上的总布置图：普鲁士蓝底上的白线、折痕、水渍和红铅笔修改。电影讲一个执意把桥造好的上校，所以把桥画成他的工程图。

styles.title: Gigi
styles.style_zh: 罗特列克美好年代石印
styles.desc_en: A Toulouse-Lautrec colour lithograph: flat poster colour, dry-brush contours, spattered ink instead of halftone, caricatured faces. Gigi's big moment is walking into Maxim's while all of Paris stares, and Lautrec drew exactly that Paris.
styles.desc_zh: 图卢兹-罗特列克式彩色石印：大块平涂、飞白轮廓、用喷溅墨点代替网点、讽刺漫画式面孔。琪琪的高光时刻是走进马克西姆餐厅、全巴黎回头盯着她，正是罗特列克画过的巴黎。

styles.title: Ben-Hur
styles.style_zh: 3D 大竞技场战车赛 · 65mm 史诗
styles.desc_en: A fully procedural 3D Circus in widescreen-epic light: hard desert sun, dust, marble and gold, a Technicolor grade and 65mm grain. The chariot race is the film's most famous sequence, so the scene is the race, under the poster's golden colossus.
styles.desc_zh: 程序生成的 3D 大竞技场，宽银幕史诗光感：沙漠烈日、沙尘、大理石和金色，特艺七彩调色加 65mm 颗粒。战车赛是全片最有名的段落，就直接拍比赛，头顶是海报上的金色巨神。

styles.title: The Apartment
styles.style_en: Saul Bass Line Titles in Black & White
styles.style_zh: Saul Bass 线条片头 · 黑白
styles.desc_en: Saul Bass's sliding white lines on black build the endless one-point-perspective office of the film's best-known shot, then fill with grey tones. Bass designed this film's titles; the only warm colour is Clawd and its key tag.
styles.desc_zh: Saul Bass 式的白线在黑底上滑入，搭出电影最有名的一点透视无尽办公大厅，再填上灰调。本片片头就是 Bass 做的；全画面唯一的暖色是 Clawd 和钥匙牌。

styles.title: West Side Story
styles.desc_en: A saturated, stage-like 3D block of the Upper West Side under a red-orange Technicolor sunset: red brick, zigzag fire escapes, rooftop water towers, posable dancers. It restages the aerial opening, the Jets' snaps and the poster's leap against the red sky.
styles.desc_zh: 红橙特艺七彩晚霞下的上西区 3D 街区，饱和、舞台化：红砖、之字形消防梯、屋顶水塔、能摆姿势的舞者人偶。重演电影的俯拍开场、Jets 打响指和海报上那一跃。

styles.title: Lawrence of Arabia
styles.desc_en: Painterly epic-poster gouache with visible directional strokes and a hard warm–cool split: amber sand against cobalt sky. Lawrence of Arabia's original poster was painted by Howard Terpning in exactly this manner.
styles.desc_zh: 看得见笔触方向的史诗海报水粉，冷暖对比强烈：琥珀色沙漠对钴蓝天空。《阿拉伯的劳伦斯》原海报就是 Howard Terpning 用这种画法画的。

styles.title: Tom Jones
blend_zh: 罗兰森/吉尔雷式手工上色
styles.desc_en: A Georgian satirical print: Hogarth's swelling burin lines and directional hatching under bright Rowlandson-style hand colour brushed slightly off the line, plus a speech balloon. The film itself imitates Hogarth's 18th-century England.
styles.desc_zh: 乔治王时代的讽刺版画：霍加斯式粗细变化的刻线和有方向的排线，上面刷罗兰森式鲜艳的手工淡彩，稍稍出线，再加一个对白气泡。电影本身就在模仿霍加斯笔下的 18 世纪英国。

styles.title: My Fair Lady
blend_zh: Cecil Beaton 阿斯科特服装
styles.desc_en: Fast, dry-edged ink line with pink and magenta watercolour washes, splatter and edges fading to white paper. The original 1964 poster was Bob Peak's ink and pink; the scene is Cecil Beaton's black-and-white Ascot.
styles.desc_zh: 快速、带飞白的墨线，配粉色和品红水彩晕染、甩点，四周化进白纸。1964 年原海报就是 Bob Peak 的墨线加粉彩；场景是 Cecil Beaton 设计的黑白阿斯科特。

styles.title: The Sound of Music
styles.style_zh: 绘本感 3D 阿尔卑斯航拍
styles.desc_en: Storybook 3D over procedural Alps: saturated emerald, cobalt and snow white, sculpted ridges, cotton-ball cumulus and gusts running through the grass. It restages the helicopter opening that ends on Maria spinning on the hilltop.
styles.desc_zh: 绘本感的 3D 程序阿尔卑斯：饱和的翠绿、钴蓝、雪白，雕塑感的山脊，棉花团积云，风吹过草地的草浪。重演开场的直升机航拍，最后落到山顶转圈的玛丽亚。

styles.title: A Man for All Seasons
styles.style_zh: 霍尔拜因都铎肖像油画
blend_zh: 霍尔拜因《托马斯·莫尔爵士像》（1527）
styles.desc_en: An Old Master oil portrait: smooth glazed modelling, fur painted hair by hair, velvet highlights, a gold chain link by link, varnish and craquelure. Holbein painted the real Thomas More in 1527, and this is his composition.
styles.desc_zh: 古典大师油画肖像：平滑罩染塑形、一根根画出的毛领、天鹅绒高光、逐环刻画的金链，再加旧光油和龟裂纹。霍尔拜因 1527 年亲手画过托马斯·莫尔，这里用的就是他的构图。

styles.title: In the Heat of the Night
styles.desc_en: A three-ink Risograph print in deep blue, poster orange-red and fluorescent pink, with halftone, grain and misregistration; light is printed as less ink. It echoes the 1967 poster's orange heat field and black silhouettes.
styles.desc_zh: 三色 Risograph 印刷：深蓝、海报橙红、荧光粉，带网点、颗粒和套色错位；光是用「少上墨」印出来的。呼应 1967 年海报的橙红热浪底和黑色剪影。

styles.title: Oliver!
styles.desc_en: A Victorian toy theatre: hand-coloured lithographed card figures with a white scissor margin, layered flats on wire slides, a gilt proscenium and flickering candle footlights throwing shadows up the scenery. Oliver! is a musical, staged here on the Victorian home stage.
styles.desc_zh: 维多利亚玩具纸剧场：手工上色的石印卡纸人物留着剪刀白边，景片分层插在滑杆上，镀金台口下的烛光脚灯把影子投上景片。《雾都孤儿》是歌舞片，正好搬上维多利亚家庭小舞台。

styles.title: Midnight Cowboy
styles.style_zh: 沃霍尔照片丝网 · Double Elvis
styles.desc_en: Warhol's photo-silkscreen: a black halftone photo printed unevenly over loose flat colour blocks on silver, the image repeated two and three times. The film has a Factory-style party in it, and his Elvis is a cowboy.
styles.desc_zh: 沃霍尔的照片丝网：黑色网点照片层印得不匀，错位地压在松散的平涂色块上，底是银色，画面重复两次、三次。片里就有沃霍尔工厂式的派对，而他画的猫王正是牛仔。

styles.title: Patton
styles.style_zh: 二战战争债券石印海报
blend_zh: 1942–45 美军征兵与战争债券海报
styles.desc_en: Flat-colour stone lithograph in the manner of 1940s US war-bond posters: posterised folds, a dark key line, halftone shadows, yellowed stock. It fits Patton's opening speech, where a tiny general stands before a stage-high flag.
styles.desc_zh: 仿 1940 年代美军战争债券海报的石印画法：分级平涂的褶皱、深色轮廓、网点阴影、泛黄的纸。对应《巴顿将军》开场：小小的将军站在一面占满舞台的巨幅国旗前训话。

styles.title: The French Connection
styles.style_zh: 高架铁下追车 · 16mm 颗粒 3D
blend_zh: 暗部偏青的冷灰印片调色
styles.desc_en: A full 3D Brooklyn avenue under the elevated railway, graded like grainy 16mm: cold grey, cyan shadows, high contrast, gate weave. The film is remembered for its car chase under the el, and only a real 3D world gives that speed.
styles.desc_zh: 整条布鲁克林高架铁下的大街用 3D 建出来，再调成粗颗粒 16mm：冷灰、暗部偏青、高反差、片门抖动。这部片最有名的就是高架铁下的追车，3D 才拍得出那种速度。

styles.title: The Godfather
blend_zh: 伦勃朗、卡拉瓦乔式罩染
styles.desc_en: Oil painting in deep amber and umber where only the top light is warm: thin transparent glazes in the darks, thick impasto on the lit edges. It recreates Gordon Willis's overhead light in the 'I believe in America' study.
styles.desc_zh: 深琥珀和赭褐的油画，只有顶光落下的地方是暖的：暗部是透明的薄罩染，受光边缘是厚涂。重现戈登·威利斯在“I believe in America”那间书房里的顶光。

styles.title: The Sting
styles.desc_en: Warm, clean magazine illustration in the Leyendecker–Rockwell line: blocky lit planes, parallel strokes, crisp dark contours. The Sting's own chapter cards imitate Saturday Evening Post covers, so its 1936 betting parlour is drawn the same way.
styles.desc_zh: Leyendecker、Rockwell 一路的杂志插画：块面受光、平行笔触、利落的深色轮廓。片中章节卡就仿《星期六晚邮报》封面，1936 年的下注厅也照这个画。

styles.title: The Godfather Part II
blend_zh: Lewis Hine 的埃利斯岛照片
styles.desc_en: A turn-of-the-century toned silver print with dyes brushed on by hand: sepia, soft lens, silver grain, foxing, a cracked corner, faint red, blue and verdigris. It shows young Vito arriving at Ellis Island in 1901, as in Lewis Hine's photographs.
styles.desc_zh: 世纪之交的调色银盐照片，手工刷色：棕褐调、柔焦、银盐颗粒、霉斑、裂角，局部淡淡的红、蓝、铜绿。画的是 1901 年少年维托抵达埃利斯岛，像 Lewis Hine 的照片。

styles.title: One Flew Over the Cuckoo's Nest
styles.desc_en: Quiet American realism after Edward Hopper: big flat planes of pale green, hard parallelograms of low morning sun, figures standing apart. It suits the ward of Cuckoo's Nest, fluorescent order broken by one act of escape.
styles.desc_zh: 仿爱德华·霍珀的安静写实：大块平整的淡绿墙面、低角度晨光投下的硬边平行四边形、彼此隔开的人。正合《飞越疯人院》的病房：日光灯下的秩序，被一次出逃打破。

styles.title: Rocky
styles.style_zh: 费城台阶日出 3D · 35mm 调色
blend_zh: 斯坦尼康跟拍与环绕升镜
styles.desc_en: A full 3D Philadelphia at sunrise, from meat locker to museum steps, graded like 1970s 35mm: cold blue sky, low gold sun, long shadows, haze, fine grain. The run up the 72 steps and the rising orbit at the top are what people remember.
styles.desc_zh: 清晨的费城整个做成 3D，从肉库到博物馆 72 级台阶，调成 70 年代 35mm：冷蓝天、低低的金色太阳、长影子、薄雾、细颗粒。跑上台阶和顶上的环绕升镜是这部片的记忆点。

styles.title: Annie Hall
styles.style_en: New Yorker Cartoon, Ink and Wash
styles.style_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画 · 墨线淡彩
styles.desc_en: A New Yorker single-panel cartoon: lively nib-pen lines, a few restrained washes, plenty of white paper and a hand-lettered caption beneath. Woody Allen's comedy shares the magazine's voice, and the lobster scene plays as one gag panel.
styles.desc_zh: 《纽约客》单格漫画：灵动的钢笔墨线、几块克制的淡彩、大量白纸，画下面一行手写图说。伍迪·艾伦的喜剧和这本杂志是一个调子，龙虾那场戏正好是一格笑话漫画。

styles.title: The Deer Hunter
styles.desc_en: Dry, finely hatched egg tempera after Andrew Wyeth: muted straw, umber and grey-green, grass drawn blade by blade, a pale empty sky. Wyeth was a Pennsylvania painter, and the 'one shot' hunt takes place in the Pennsylvania mountains above a steel town.
styles.desc_zh: 仿安德鲁·怀斯的蛋彩：干燥细密的交叉短笔，低饱和的草黄、赭褐、灰绿，草叶一根根画出来，天空苍白。怀斯是宾州画家，“一枪”猎鹿就在宾州钢铁小镇上方的山里。

styles.title: Kramer vs. Kramer
styles.desc_en: A kitchen drawn by a child in wax crayon: wobbly lines, colour pressed into the paper grain and over the edges, labels and arrows, a smiling sun. It is Billy's view of making French toast with his father.
styles.desc_zh: 孩子用蜡笔画的厨房：歪扭的线、用力涂进纸纹又涂出边界的颜色、标签和箭头、带笑脸的太阳。这是比利眼里他和爸爸做法式吐司的样子。

styles.title: Ordinary People
blend_zh: Winslow Homer 与 John Singer Sargent
styles.desc_en: Transparent watercolour in layered glazes: wet-in-wet sky and lake, tide-mark edges, blooms, white paper left for highlights, autumn gold and rust against cool grey-blue. It matches the quiet, sad Lake Forest autumn of the film's opening.
styles.desc_zh: 层层叠色的透明水彩：湿画法的天空和湖面、水渍边线、回流花、留白的纸当高光，秋天的金和锈红配上冷灰蓝。对上影片开场那个安静又带点忧伤的 Lake Forest 秋天。

styles.title: Chariots of Fire
blend_zh: Jean Droit 的 1924 奥运海报
styles.desc_en: A four-colour stone lithograph after Jean Droit's 1924 Paris Olympics poster: classical bodies, a few inks, clumped stone grain, ragged registration on cream paper. Chariots of Fire builds to the 1924 Games, so its beach run becomes that poster coming to life.
styles.desc_zh: 仿 Jean Droit 1924 巴黎奥运海报的四色石印：古典人体、有限油墨、成团的石版颗粒、参差套色。《烈火战车》讲的是 1924 年奥运，海滩长跑像那张海报活了过来。

styles.title: Gandhi
styles.style_zh: 拉贾斯坦手工木刻印花布
styles.desc_en: Hand block print on cotton in indigo, madder and turmeric with a carved black key block, misregistered at the block seams, dye bleeding along the weave. Homespun khadi was Gandhi's symbol, so the Salt March is printed as cloth.
styles.desc_zh: 棉布上的手工木刻印花：靛蓝、茜草红、姜黄加黑色雕版轮廓，版缝处套色错位，染料顺着经纬渗开。手纺土布是甘地的象征，所以食盐进军就印成一块布。

styles.title: Terms of Endearment
blend_zh: SX-70 与宝丽来 600 相片
styles.desc_en: An open family album of faded Polaroids and Kodacolor snapshots, with teal-lifted blacks, creamy highlights and white borders, where one Polaroid comes alive as a panning shot of the beach drive. Terms of Endearment spans thirty years of a mother and daughter.
styles.desc_zh: 摊开的家庭相册，里面是褪色的宝丽来和柯达快照：发青的黑、奶油色高光、白边。其中一张宝丽来活过来，变成海滩飞车的追拍照片。《母女情深》讲的是母女三十年。

styles.title: Amadeus
styles.style_zh: 洛可可剪影 · 烛光金色歌剧院
styles.desc_en: Black paper profiles with gold-bronzed rims fill a horseshoe of gilt boxes and red velvet facing a starry stage. Amadeus peaks with Mozart's opening night, so one frame holds the pit, the stage, the audience and Salieri brooding in his box.
styles.desc_zh: 黑纸剪成的侧面人像镶着金边，坐满马蹄形的金色包厢和红丝绒，对着星空布景的舞台。《莫扎特传》的高光是首演之夜，一个画面装下乐池、舞台、观众和暗处的萨列里。

styles.title: Out of Africa
styles.desc_en: Real-time 3D flight over a soda lake: a chrome-yellow Gipsy Moth, thousands of flamingos lifting off, hazy amber light. The film's best-remembered sequence is Denys flying Karen over Kenya, down to the hand she reaches back across the cockpits.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的低空飞行：铬黄色双翼机掠过苏打湖，上万只火烈鸟惊起，琥珀色薄雾光。这部片最被记住的就是丹尼斯带凯伦飞越肯尼亚，和她向后座伸出的那只手。

styles.title: Platoon
styles.style_en: Combat Artist Field Sketch · Pen & Wash
styles.style_zh: 越战随军速写 · 钢笔淡彩
blend_zh: 美国陆军越战战地艺术计划
styles.desc_en: Quick, hard pen lines with loose washes of olive, ochre, smoke grey and fire orange on sketchbook paper left bare at the edges. It reads as a war artist drawing on the spot, close to the film's infantryman's view of Vietnam.
styles.desc_zh: 快而有力的钢笔线，橄榄绿、土黄、烟灰和火光橙的淡彩，速写本纸四边留白。像随军画家在现场画下的，贴近这部片从步兵眼里看越战的视角。

styles.title: The Last Emperor
styles.style_zh: 工笔重彩 · 绢本宫廷画
styles.desc_en: Iron-wire outlines and graded mineral washes of azurite, malachite, cinnabar and gold on silk, with a ruled-line palace and thousands of kneeling officials. The boy emperor's coronation is a Qing court ceremony, painted the way Qing court painters recorded ceremonies.
styles.desc_zh: 绢本上的铁线描和层层渲染的石青、石绿、朱砂、泥金，界画的宫殿，几千名跪拜的百官。小皇帝的登基是清宫仪典，就用清宫画师记录仪典的画法来画。

styles.title: Rain Man
styles.style_zh: 80 年代喷枪插画 + 雷蒙的计数
styles.desc_en: Smooth airbrushed gradients, hard masked edges, chrome glints and pink-and-mint neon, overlaid with thin cyan callouts that count. It pairs the film's 1980s look with what Raymond sees: 82, 82, 82, 246 toothpicks, then cards counted at the table.
styles.desc_zh: 平滑的喷枪渐变、硬边遮罩、镀铬高光和粉绿霓虹，叠一层细细的青色计数标注。80 年代画风配上雷蒙眼里的世界：82、82、82，共 246 根牙签，还有牌桌算牌。

styles.title: Driving Miss Daisy
blend_zh: 诺曼·洛克威尔油画插画
3D 建模的车再铺油画笔触
styles.desc_en: Solid, warm Rockwell realism: clean edges, visible oil strokes, afternoon light through oaks, every neighbour busy with something. The film is two people in one car on a 1950s Atlanta street, which is a Saturday Evening Post cover already.
styles.desc_zh: 扎实温暖的洛克威尔写实：边缘干净、笔触可见，午后阳光穿过橡树，邻居各忙各的。这部片就是 50 年代亚特兰大一辆车里的两个人，本身就像一张《星期六晚邮报》封面。

styles.title: Dances with Wolves
styles.style_zh: 邓巴日记 · 铅笔 + 透明水彩
styles.desc_en: A soldier's field journal: pressure-varied pencil, transparent watercolour, yellowed rag paper, inked script and pencil notes in the margins. Dunbar writes and sketches in his diary throughout the film, so the prairie appears as his sketch coming to life.
styles.desc_zh: 一个军人的野外日记：轻重有变化的铅笔线、透明水彩、泛黄的布浆纸、墨水手写和页边的铅笔批注。邓巴在片中一直写画日记，所以草原是从他的速写里活过来的。

styles.title: The Silence of the Lambs
styles.style_zh: 手工上色的博物学铜版画
styles.desc_en: Fine engraved hatching and stipple under thin hand-coloured tints, with plate numbers and Latin labels on yellowed paper. The poster's death's-head moth belongs on a specimen plate, and the same cold engraving carries on into Lecter's cell.
styles.desc_zh: 细密的铜版排线和点刻，上面薄薄地手工上色，图版编号和拉丁文标签印在泛黄的纸上。海报上的鬼脸天蛾本就该钉在标本图版上，同样冷峻的铜版画法一直延伸到莱克特的囚室。

styles.title: Unforgiven
styles.style_zh: 雷明顿西部油画 · 晚霞与雨夜
styles.desc_en: Thick Western oil painting in two keys: Remington's red-gold plains at sunset and his blue-green nocturnes lit by warm windows. Unforgiven opens and closes on a silhouette at a grave against the sunset, and its showdown comes in a town on a rainy night.
styles.desc_zh: 两种调子的厚涂西部油画：雷明顿金红晚霞下的平原，和他晚年被暖黄窗光点亮的蓝绿夜景。《不可饶恕》以夕阳下坟前的剪影开场和收尾，决战发生在雨夜的小镇。

styles.title: Schindler's List
styles.style_zh: 黑白胶片 · 唯一的红大衣
styles.desc_en: Cold, high-contrast black and white with coarse grain and haloed highlights, where only the girl's red coat and Clawd's orange keep their colour. It follows Spielberg's own device: the red coat and the Sabbath candle flames are the film's only colour.
styles.desc_zh: 冷灰、高反差的黑白，粗颗粒，高光晕开；只有小女孩的红大衣和 Clawd 的橙色有颜色。这正是斯皮尔伯格的手法：红大衣和安息日烛火是全片仅有的彩色。

styles.title: Forrest Gump
styles.style_en: Sabuda Pop-up Book on a Real Desk
styles.style_zh: 立体书 · 真实书桌上的纸艺
styles.desc_en: Printed cards standing up in parallel folds, with white cores, grey board edges, layered shadows and shallow focus, on a walnut desk. Forrest tells his life on a bench, so each page that pops up is one chapter.
styles.desc_zh: 平行折立起来的印刷卡片，白色纸芯、灰色纸板边、层与层之间的投影和浅景深，放在胡桃木书桌上。阿甘坐在长椅上把一生讲成故事，翻开一页就立起一段经历。

styles.title: Braveheart
styles.style_zh: 泥金手抄本 · 贴金细密画
styles.desc_en: A medieval manuscript page: burnished gold with punched dots, lapis blue, vermilion, textura script, and a battle miniature framed like a window. Braveheart is a medieval Scottish legend, and its last cry, FREEDOM, becomes the illuminated initial.
styles.desc_zh: 一页中世纪手抄本：带冲压点的磨光金箔、青金石蓝、朱红、哥特体字，中间一幅窗口似的战役细密画。《勇敢的心》是苏格兰传奇，片尾那声 FREEDOM 做成泥金首字母。

styles.title: The English Patient
blend_zh: 剪贴拼贴：胶带、照片、地图
styles.desc_en: Watercolour sketches taped into an old book among maps, photos, notes and pressed flowers, in the poster's amber-sepia. Almásy's Herodotus, stuffed with his paintings and notes, frames the film, so the camera pushes through one painting into the Cave of Swimmers.
styles.desc_zh: 贴在旧书里的水彩速写，夹着地图、照片、便条和压花，整体是海报的琥珀褐。艾玛殊那本塞满画和笔记的希罗多德是全片的框架，镜头就穿过一张水彩进入游泳者洞穴。

styles.title: Titanic
blend_zh: 按真实尺寸建模的 three.js 船
styles.desc_en: White lines on Prussian-blue drafting paper stand up into perspective and develop into a full-colour 3D ship at sunset, then fall into night. The ship is the film's icon, so its yard drawing and the real ship are the same model.
styles.desc_zh: 普鲁士蓝晒图纸上的白线立起来、长出透视，再显影成夕阳下全彩的 3D 船，一路入夜。船本身就是这部片的标志，所以船厂图纸和实景用的是同一艘模型。

styles.title: Shakespeare in Love
styles.style_zh: 希利亚德伊丽莎白细密画
blend_zh: 羊皮纸上的不透明水彩
styles.desc_en: An Elizabethan portrait miniature in Nicholas Hilliard's manner: body colour on vellum, an ultramarine ground, shell-gold lettering, white eglantine. The film is set in Shakespeare's London, and the miniature was that court's own form of portrait.
styles.desc_zh: 学尼古拉斯·希利亚德的伊丽莎白时代宫廷细密画：羊皮纸上的不透明水彩、群青底、贝壳金题字、白色野蔷薇。影片发生在莎士比亚的伦敦，细密画正是那个宫廷自己的肖像形式。

styles.title: American Beauty
styles.style_zh: 郊区对称电影画面 + DV 录像
blend_zh: Conrad Hall 式正面对称构图
90 年代 DV 摄像机录像
styles.desc_en: Two looks cut together: a clean, saturated, dead-on shot of a suburban house with a red door and red roses, then soft, noisy camcorder video with a REC overlay. It mirrors the film's split between Lester's polished suburbia and Ricky's tape of the dancing bag.
styles.desc_zh: 两种画面剪在一起：先是干净饱和、正面对称的郊区住宅（红门、红玫瑰），再切到带 REC 界面的低清 DV 录像。对应影片里莱斯特体面的郊区和里基拍下的那段塑料袋录像。

styles.title: Gladiator
styles.desc_en: Everything is laid in square stone and glass tesserae: courses follow the outlines, flat areas run in straight rows, gold-leaf tiles glint. The film's world is Rome, so the arena and Elysium are built as a Roman floor mosaic.
styles.desc_zh: 整幅画用方形石子和玻璃嵌片铺成：轮廓边的石子顺着形体排，平面处一行行直排，金箔玻璃片会闪。影片本身就在罗马，所以斗兽场和极乐麦田都做成罗马地面马赛克。

styles.title: A Beautiful Mind
styles.style_zh: 窗上公式与黑板粉笔 + 金色连线
styles.desc_en: Handwritten maths on two surfaces, white marker on a Gothic library window and chalk on slate, with digits that light up and join in gold lines. It shows Nash seeing patterns the way the film does: a light in his head, not a computer interface.
styles.desc_zh: 两种表面上的手写数学：哥特式图书馆窗玻璃上的白色油性笔、黑板上的粉笔，数字亮起，被金线连起来。这是片中纳什看见规律的方式：是他脑中的光，不是电脑界面。

styles.title: Chicago
styles.style_en: Fosse Stage in Red and Black
styles.style_zh: 福斯舞台：红黑聚光剪影
styles.desc_en: A black stage cut by hard spotlights: six cells with women in red-rimmed silhouette, a neon C, sequins, haze, and Clawd in a white follow spot. It is the 'Cell Block Tango' number from Rob Marshall's film, in the poster's red and black.
styles.desc_zh: 黑色舞台被硬边聚光切开：六间牢房里是勾红边的女囚剪影，背后霓虹 C，亮片和烟雾，Clawd 在白色追光里。这是电影版的「Cell Block Tango」，用海报的红黑。

styles.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Return of the King
styles.style_zh: 艾伦·李式水彩 + 托尔金地图
blend_zh: 水彩加铅笔的概念插画
styles.desc_en: Soft watercolour and pencil landscapes with deep aerial perspective, plus an ink map on stained parchment. Alan Lee and John Howe drew the films' concept art, so the journey is told the way the trilogy was first drawn.
styles.desc_zh: 柔和的水彩加铅笔风景，空气透视很深，再加一张羊皮纸上的墨线地图。电影的概念画就是艾伦·李和约翰·豪画的，所以这段旅程按三部曲最初被画出来的样子来讲。

styles.title: Million Dollar Baby
styles.desc_en: An original 16-bit arcade fighting-game screen: health bars, a round timer, ROUND 1 / FIGHT!, a combo counter, hit-stop and a big K.O. A boxing film about a shot at the title becomes one round told in arcade grammar.
styles.desc_zh: 原创的 16-bit 街机格斗游戏画面：血条、回合计时、ROUND 1 / FIGHT!、连击数、命中停顿和巨大的 K.O.。一部拳击冠军赛的电影，变成用街机语法打完的一回合。

styles.title: Crash
styles.style_zh: 洛杉矶夜景光轨 + 飘雪
blend_zh: 变形宽银幕光条与胶片颗粒
styles.desc_en: A polished night photograph made in code: freeway light trails in white and red, sodium orange against neon cyan, wet asphalt, bokeh, and snow that shows only where light hits it. Crash ends on a rare snowfall over Los Angeles.
styles.desc_zh: 用代码画的精修夜景照片：高架上白色和红色的车灯光轨、钠灯橙对霓虹青、湿路面反光、焦外光斑，还有只在光里才看得见的雪。《撞车》的结尾正是洛杉矶难得的一场雪。

styles.title: The Departed
styles.style_zh: 波士顿红砖墙模板涂鸦
styles.desc_en: Flat spray-paint stencil layers with overspray and drips, the paint sinking into brick mortar, beside a torn paste-up poster. The Departed ends on a rat crossing a railing below the State House dome, and street stencils have their own tradition of rats.
styles.desc_zh: 平涂的多层喷漆模板，有喷雾毛边和流挂，漆吃进砖缝，旁边一张撕破的糊贴海报。《无间行者》最后一个镜头是老鼠爬过州议会金顶下的栏杆，街头模板涂鸦也一直爱画老鼠。

styles.title: No Country for Old Men
styles.style_zh: 3D 西德州荒原黄昏（迪金斯光）
styles.desc_en: A real-time 3D West Texas at dusk: the sun pressed onto the horizon, long shadows toward the camera, desaturated ochre and grey-green, fine grain. It follows Roger Deakins' light for the Coens and the poster's backlit man with a case.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的西德州黄昏荒原：太阳压在地平线上，长影子朝着镜头，低饱和的土黄和灰绿，细颗粒。照着迪金斯为科恩兄弟拍的光，和海报上逆光里提着箱子的人。

styles.title: Slumdog Millionaire
styles.style_zh: 答题节目演播室 + 孟买橙青
blend_zh: Anthony Dod Mantle 的橙青色调
styles.desc_en: A hard-lit TV studio in blue-violet with gold highlights, moving-head beams and lens flares, then a hot orange-and-teal Mumbai rooftop. The film cuts between the quiz show's final question and the slums Jamal came from.
styles.desc_zh: 蓝紫色加金色高光的电视演播室，摇头灯光束、镜头光斑；然后切到饱和橙青色的孟买屋顶。影片本身就在答题节目的最后一题和贾马尔出身的贫民窟之间来回切。

styles.title: The Hurt Locker
styles.desc_en: A page from an army bomb-disposal manual: even black lines, hatched shadows, stippled sand, numbered callouts, an exploded IED diagram, a little olive and sand. The Hurt Locker is about procedure under pressure, and a manual page is procedure drawn.
styles.desc_zh: 一页美军拆弹手册：均匀黑线、排线阴影、点描沙土、带圈编号和引线、IED 分解图，只有一点橄榄绿和沙色。《拆弹部队》讲高压下的程序，手册图就是画出来的程序。

styles.title: The King's Speech
styles.style_zh: 斑驳墙 + 金色广播间
styles.desc_en: Painterly interiors with heavy wall texture: Logue's peeling, many-coloured wall in cool grey-green, then a padded broadcast booth in amber gold with a sprung microphone and fine gold sound waves. It follows Eve Stewart's famous wall and the poster's gold.
styles.desc_zh: 墙面肌理很重的油画质感室内：罗格诊室那面冷灰绿的多层斑驳墙，再到琥珀金的软包广播间、弹簧吊着的话筒和细细的金色声波。照着 Eve Stewart 设计的墙和海报的金黄。

styles.title: The Artist
blend_zh: 好莱坞片厂的魅力布光
styles.desc_en: Clean, glossy black and white with bright highlights and soft greys, Art Deco intertitles, light flicker and grain; Clawd is the only colour. The Artist was a 2011 love letter to silent Hollywood, so this is a sharper, cleaner silent film than No. 1.
styles.desc_zh: 干净发亮的黑白：高光明亮、灰阶柔和，装饰艺术边框的字幕卡，轻微闪烁和颗粒；Clawd 是唯一的颜色。《艺术家》是 2011 年写给默片好莱坞的情书，所以比第 1 部更精致。

styles.title: Argo
styles.style_zh: 杰克·柯比 70 年代漫画页
styles.desc_en: A 1970s Kirby comic book on a production desk: heavy ink, Kirby Krackle, Ben-Day dots on yellowed newsprint. The film's fake sci-fi movie was sold with real Kirby concept art, so the pages run from fake epic to the real runway escape.
styles.desc_zh: 摊在制片桌上的 70 年代柯比漫画：粗墨线、柯比能量泡、泛黄新闻纸上的四色网点。片中那部假科幻片用的正是柯比画的概念图，所以漫画从假史诗一路翻到真实的跑道出逃。

styles.title: 12 Years a Slave
styles.desc_en: An 1850s silver-plate photograph in a brass mat and velvet case, developing from blank: a violin on a chair, Clawd beside it, head bowed. It is the photography of Solomon Northup's own time, and tells the film with one object and no people.
styles.desc_zh: 铜框丝绒盒里的 1850 年代银版照片，从空白显影：椅子上靠着小提琴，Clawd 低头站在旁边。这是所罗门·诺瑟普那个年代的照相术，只用一件物件讲这部片，不画人。

styles.title: Birdman
styles.desc_en: A detailed 3D backstage of a Broadway theatre shot as a handheld long take, warm tungsten against cold fluorescent, ending in the glare of Times Square. Birdman is remembered for looking like one unbroken shot, so the style is the camera move itself.
styles.desc_zh: 细致的 3D 百老汇剧院后台，用手持长镜头拍：暖钨丝灯对冷日光灯，最后冲进时代广场的强光。《鸟人》最出名的就是假装一镜到底，所以这段的风格就是那条运镜。

styles.title: Spotlight
styles.style_zh: 缩微胶片阅读机 · 报纸网点
blend_zh: 图书馆缩微胶片阅读机
styles.desc_en: A newspaper-halftone picture seen on the green-grey screen of a library microfiche reader, with scan lines, a rolling scan bar and dust on the glass. The reporters dug the story out of archives like this, and the fiche transport replaces the cuts.
styles.desc_zh: 印成报纸网点的画面，放到缩微胶片阅读机的灰绿屏幕上：扫描线、滚动的扫描光带、玻璃上的灰尘。片中记者就在这种档案里挖出真相，换镜头也做成胶片横移。

styles.title: Moonlight
blend_zh: 青绿 / 品红 / 蓝紫双色调
styles.desc_en: Painted oil portraiture in saturated teal, magenta and moon-blue, with sculpted heads repainted in form-following strokes. It takes the film's title line, "in moonlight black boys look blue", literally.
styles.desc_zh: 饱满的青绿、品红和月光蓝油画肖像，雕出来的头像再用顺着形体的笔触重新画一遍。直接照着片名那句「月光下，黑人男孩看起来是蓝色的」来画。

styles.title: The Shape of Water
blend_zh: Dan Laustsen 的青绿配暖金调色
styles.desc_en: A flooded 1960s bathroom and a lab tank in real-time 3D, soaked in teal with moving caustics, light shafts from above, bubbles and warm practical lamps. Del Toro's film lives in that green-blue water, so the whole segment is shot inside it.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的被淹浴室和实验室水箱，整片浸在青绿里：流动的焦散、从上方落下的光束、气泡和几盏暖色灯。德尔·托罗这部片就泡在这种水里，所以整段在水中拍。

styles.title: Green Book
blend_zh: Curt Teich 亚麻纹明信片
styles.desc_en: A "Greetings from the Deep South" linen postcard that comes alive: woven paper texture, airbrushed saturated colour, chrome sparkles. The film is a 1962 road trip through the South, the same roads these cards sold to tourists.
styles.desc_zh: 一张「南方问候」亚麻纹明信片活了过来：布纹纸、喷枪上的饱和色、镀铬上的星形闪光。影片是 1962 年穿越美国南方的公路旅行，走的正是这种明信片上的路。

styles.title: Parasite
blend_zh: 建筑剖切填充与比例人
styles.desc_en: One architectural section through a Seoul hillside: the glass house on top, a hidden bunker beneath, stairs down to a flooding half-basement, in fine lines and soft material colours. Parasite is built on that vertical class divide, so one drawing holds the film.
styles.desc_zh: 一张剖开首尔山坡的建筑剖面图：山顶的玻璃豪宅、地下的秘密掩体、一路通到被淹的半地下室，细线、柔和的材质色。《寄生虫》建在这种上下的阶级落差上，一张图装下整部片。

styles.title: Nomadland
styles.desc_en: Chalky soft-pastel strokes on grey-violet paper, the sky turning from gold to rose to violet over a wide plain with an old camper van. Nomadland lives in that long, empty horizon at dusk, and pastel keeps it soft and quiet.
styles.desc_zh: 灰紫色纸上的粉质色粉笔触，一片开阔的平原和一辆旧房车，天空从金黄变成玫瑰色再到紫色。《无依之地》就活在黄昏那条又长又空的地平线上，色粉让它安静、柔和。

styles.title: CODA
styles.desc_en: A polished sperm-whale tooth on an oak table, engraved in fine black lines with touches of red, blue and yellow: a Gloucester fishing boat, the family hauling nets, Ruby singing at the bow. It is the folk art of CODA's own New England coast.
styles.desc_zh: 橡木桌上一颗抛光的抹香鲸牙，刻着细密的黑线，点缀红、蓝、黄：格洛斯特的渔船、收网的一家人、船头唱歌的鲁比。这是影片所在的新英格兰海岸自己的民间工艺。

styles.title: Everything Everywhere All at Once
styles.style_zh: 光线步进多元宇宙跳切
blend_zh: GLSL 光线步进的多个宇宙
一个宇宙一种画法（写实办公室、超现实宇宙、风景、广告）
styles.desc_en: Four universes, each with its own look, all ray-marched in real time: a cold-green IRS office, a hot-dog-finger piano lit like an advert, a silent canyon of googly-eyed rocks, the Everything Bagel as a black hole. A googly eye jumps between them.
styles.desc_zh: 四个宇宙四种画法，全部实时光线步进：冷绿的国税局、广告光下的热狗手指钢琴、贴大眼睛石头的寂静峡谷、变成黑洞的万物贝果。像电影里一样，靠大眼睛贴纸在宇宙间跳转。

styles.title: Oppenheimer
styles.style_zh: 3D 粒子火球 · IMAX 颗粒
blend_zh: 三位一体试验高速照片
styles.desc_en: The Trinity test site before dawn rebuilt in real-time 3D, with a fireball of about 720,000 particles, quantum visions of orbits and waves, deep pre-dawn blue against orange-gold fire and IMAX-style grain. Oppenheimer is built on that one light.
styles.desc_zh: 用实时 3D 重建黎明前的三位一体试验场：约 72 万粒子的火球、轨道和波组成的量子幻象，深蓝夜色对橙金火光，加 IMAX 式颗粒。《奥本海默》就围着这一道光展开。

styles.title: Anora
styles.desc_en: Glowing neon tubes in pink, cyan and orange, smeared into wet boardwalk planks and caught in falling snow, with bloom, bokeh and grain. Anora runs from Brighton Beach's Cyrillic neon to a Vegas wedding sign, so the whole segment is lit by tubes.
styles.desc_zh: 粉、青、橙的霓虹灯管发着光，倒影拖在湿栈道上，落进飘雪里，加上辉光、虚焦光斑和颗粒。《阿诺拉》从布莱顿海滩的俄文霓虹走到维加斯的婚礼招牌，整段都用灯管照亮。

styles.title: One Battle After Another
styles.style_zh: 3D 起伏公路追车 · 长焦压缩
styles.desc_en: A real-time 3D desert road that rises and falls like a roller coaster, three cars chasing over the dips, shot through extreme long lenses with heat haze, bleached sunlight and fine grain. It rebuilds the film's best-known sequence, the dip-road chase.
styles.desc_zh: 实时 3D 的沙漠公路，像过山车一样一起一伏，三辆车翻着一道道坡追逐，用超长焦拍，带热浪、漂白的强光和细颗粒。复刻的是这部片最有名的段落：起伏公路追车。
